import pathlib,subprocess
root=pathlib.Path('/tmp/cfc-key-comparison')
for i in range(5):
 with (root/f'collector-{i}.json').open('w') as out,(root/f'collector-{i}.log').open('w') as err:
  subprocess.run(['deno','run','--no-lock','-A','--config',str(root/'baseline/deno.jsonc'),str(root/'collector.mjs'),*[(root/x).as_uri() for x in ['baseline','guarded','length']]],stdout=out,stderr=err,check=True)
 print('collector',i,flush=True)

from pathlib import Path
import shutil
repo=Path.cwd();base=Path('/tmp/string-tuple-keys/baseline')
shutil.copyfile(repo/'packages/utils/src/string-tuple-key.ts',base/'packages/utils/src/string-tuple-key.ts')
p=base/'packages/utils/src/string-tuple-key.json-baseline.ts';p.write_text('export const stringTupleKey = (parts: readonly string[]): string => JSON.stringify(parts);\n')
p=base/'packages/utils/deno.jsonc';t=p.read_text();p.write_text(t.replace('    "./staged-map":','    "./string-tuple-key": "./src/string-tuple-key.ts",\n    "./staged-map":'))
b=repo/'packages/utils/test/string-tuple-key.bench.ts'
(base/'packages/utils/test/string-tuple-key.bench.ts').write_text(b.read_text().replace('../src/string-tuple-key.ts','../src/string-tuple-key.json-baseline.ts'))
shutil.copyfile(b,base/'packages/utils/test/string-tuple-key.final.bench.ts')
for source,bench in [('cfc/prepare','cfc-consumed-source-dedup'),('scheduler/invalidation','scheduler-invalid-causes')]:
 shutil.copyfile(repo/f'packages/runner/src/{source}.ts',base/f'packages/runner/src/{source}.key-final.ts')
 p=base/f'packages/runner/test/{bench}.bench.ts'
 (p.parent/f'{bench}.final.bench.ts').write_text(p.read_text().replace(f'../src/{source}.ts',f'../src/{source}.key-final.ts'))
